units: B. Mets. 105ᵇ ramification (סוכה) is considered weak, שנחבאת בחֶזְיוֹנָהּ (or בחזיונָה) when it is hidden under (fully covered with) moss. [Ar. ed. בחיזונה, ed. Koh. בחזיונה; comment.: the grip of the hand, fr. אחז; marg. emend.: באֲחַזְיוֹנָה, v. Tosaf. a. l.]—

<cite ref="Eruvin 28a:6">Erub. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אבל לא בחזין ולא בחזניות</he> Ms. M. (Rabb. D. S. a. l. note quotes <he>חזיונות</he>) but neither with lichens nor with lichen dishes (Lecanora esculenta).

senses.gloss: pl. חֶזְיוֹנוֹת lichen, scab; trnsf. irregular lumps of clouds.
units: Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ bot. a cloud is called ḥaziz (v. next w.) שהוא עושה … ח׳ ח׳ וכ׳ for He makes the sky full of irregular lumps (cumuli), as we read (Zech. X, 1), the Lord makes ḥăzizim
